_meta.purpose: Authored end-of-lesson recap questions, keyed by library item id.
_meta.why: Most short lessons teach by doing and state no extractable fact, so a recap cannot be derived from their steps. These are written against each lesson's own content and merged into the library by tool/merge_recaps.py.
rules: A prompt must never contain its own answer (enforced by lesson_recap_test.dart).
Two questions minimum, options short enough to tap on a phone.
Distractors must be plausible but clearly wrong to a child who understood.
_meta.translation: English source. Locale bundles overlay by key and fall back to English, so untranslated recaps are safe to ship.
